# Harbor master's daily brief

Wind **light**, swell *low*, visibility <u>good</u>; the ~~north~~ south channel is open. Tide tables are at [the harbor office](https://harbor.example/tides), and the buoy feed reports `buoy.read(7)`.\
Pressure 1013 hPa, water at 14 m<sup>3</sup>/s, nitrate NO<sub>3</sub>.

<span data-color="blue">Blue water</span>, <mark data-color="yellow">yellow flags</mark> and [<span data-color="red"><mark data-color="gray">**red alerts**</mark></span>](https://harbor.example/alerts).
